title: EXPRESSION OF CONCERN: Differential selection on sprint speed and ad libitum feeding behaviour in active vs. sit‐and‐wait foraging spiders
content:
EXPRESSION OF CONCERN: J. N. Pruitt, “Differential Selection on Sprint Speed and Ad Libitum Feeding Behaviour in Active vs. Sit-and-Wait Foraging Spiders,” Functional Ecology 26, no. 2 (2010): 392–399, https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1365-2435.2009.01655.x.

This Expression of Concern is for the above article, published online on 26 February 2010 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), and has been issued by agreement between the journal Executive Editor, Enrico Rezende; Managing Editor, Jennifer Meyer; British Ecological Society; and John Wiley & Sons Ltd. In 2020, concerns were raised about potential data management issues and irregular patterns in the data, which potentially impact the article's conclusions. The authors responded to an inquiry by the journal but were not able to provide the original data files. Due to the lack of original data available to the authors, the journal contacted the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, where the data were originally collected, to request an investigation. Therefore, the journal published an Editorial Note [https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2435.13639] to disclose the investigation.

In 2025, the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, informed the publisher that it has subsequently closed the investigation due to administrative requirements. The Expression of Concern has been agreed to because the concerns regarding the validity of the data remain unresolved. Therefore, the journal has decided to issue an Expression of Concern to inform and alert readers.
